research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Rebellion Defense is researching systems and methods for processing remote sensing data, focusing on generating visual color images from such data. Their work involves obtaining remote sensing data, pre-processing it, and then using a generative neural approach to produce visual outputs. This area of research and development centers on advanced image generation and data processing techniques for remote sensing applications.

overview_description.description: Rebellion Defense turns data into a decision advantage, developing advanced software to stay ahead of national security threats. It equips warfighters with cutting-edge capabilities to detect, deter, and outpace adversaries at speed and scale by combining private-sector tech experts with defense veterans. Their mission is to build transformative technology for defense and national security.
